_doc: Accepted RDL ladder state. scripts/rdl.py ci-blocking fails only on families that are new at rung 3 or above, or that have escalated above the rung recorded here. History does not fail a build; regressions do.
reason: Ladder state as landed on 2026-08-24. git_lock_family and guard_not_executed reached rung 4 in this session and their gate, scripts/git_unlock.py, landed in the same change set. Accepted so the gate measures future regressions rather than failing forever on its own first entries.
